reviews.evidence: Ships curated Markdown memory, bounded-index guards, validators, host init/read-only adapters, continuity sync and safe uninstall behavior.
reviews.concern: No visible product output; most commands install or wire the protocol rather than demonstrate daily operation.

reviews.evidence: Natural-language SQL analysis, schema governance, charts/dashboards and offline HTML reports have Web/TUI steps, five scenarios and screenshots.
reviews.concern: Safety is clearly described, but no tests, query limits, timeout behavior or failure troubleshooting are shown.

reviews.evidence: Runnable TUI/headless agent with anchored edits, subagents, sessions, skills, hooks, lazy MCP, permissions, provider routing and screenshots.
reviews.concern: Use cases are mostly operational coding modes rather than a broad set of explicit end-user scenarios.

reviews.evidence: Catalog skill discovers eligible GitHub-topic repos, shortlists candidates, identifies install form, audits risk, requests consent, installs and verifies.
reviews.concern: No demonstrated search result or verification report; linked plugins' capabilities and catalog cards receive no credit.

reviews.evidence: Novel and short-drama workflows ship with roles, skills, staged Markdown artifacts, three-pane editing, file following, previews and two demo GIFs.
reviews.concern: Operational guidance is brief, and validation evidence is asserted rather than shown with commands or results.

reviews.evidence: Maps Pi's plugin ABI onto DSH tools, models, sessions, UI, OAuth and subagents; includes runnable MCP flow, examples and extensive validation matrices.
reviews.concern: Many scenarios depend on third-party Pi packages; their own abilities are not counted as bridge capabilities.

reviews.evidence: Searches three anime sources, renders paged cards and resource details, handles magnets/torrents and rule-based streaming; screenshots show results.
reviews.concern: Only three concise prompt scenarios are stated; streaming depends on third-party sources and a limited parser subset.

reviews.evidence: Ready GUI/TUI distribution shares sessions and host lifecycle, exposes presets, files/Git/terminal/browser/diffs, model choice, doctor and host CLI.
reviews.concern: Developer-preview compatibility and release availability may change; explicit task scenarios are relatively sparse.

reviews.evidence: Creates, edits, verifies, previews, imports and exports Sheets, Docs, Slides, Bases and Boards with isolated approval workflows and rich demos.
reviews.concern: Some Slide checks require Chrome; Board export/advanced editing and Slide masters, layouts and notes are unsupported.

reviews.evidence: Multi-theme note app supports DSH/agent creation, images, sync, AI polishing, public-account paste and image/Markdown/HTML exports with many demos.
reviews.concern: Operational limits and troubleshooting are thin; several optional features require separately configured services.
